remarks: *2 occupants max* Welcome to this updated 2nd-floor apartment located on a quiet dead-end road in the desirable Harbor Shores neighborhood. The home features a spacious living room with beautiful views of Long Island Sound and Sheffield Island. The newly updated kitchen offers ample space for a dining table and includes a large pantry for extra storage. Washer and dryer are conveniently located on the main floor for communal use. Enjoy the coastal lifestyle with the ability to launch your kayak or paddleboard at the end of the road. Additional features include off-street parking for two cars. This prime location offers easy access to nearby amenities including Woodward Park with pickleball courts just a stone's throw away. Metro-North is only a 5-minute drive, Downtown Washington Street offers a wide selection of restaurants and shopping, and Calf Pasture Beach is just minutes away!  Ideal for two working professionals, with strong credit, proof of income, and references. (No Pets, don't ask)  Available ASAP
